explanation: The statement is about the library's own `monomialSpan m`, the span of the q-expansions q4^(3(m-b))·qΔ^b. It says the q-expansion of any weight-12m level-one modular form lies in that span. I found no `monomialSpan` in Mathlib. The nearest results are in Mathlib/NumberTheory/ModularForms/LevelOne/DimensionFormula.lean (`qExpansion_eq_qExpansion_discriminant_mul`, `discriminantEquiv`, `dimension_level_one`). The proof already uses those as ingredients, in an induction on m. None of them states this span membership, and no short derivation from them gives it.
